task: Implement AI Unified Review & Reputation Management System
learnings: To add a database migration, place the file in both src/server/db/migrations and src/server/migrations. Use `.sql` extension and sequential numbering.
For new backend routes, update the routing logic and ensure any required state correctly injects the needed dependencies.

If updating a grpc service like growth_service, ensure the proto file (`src/proto/hub.proto`) and the Rust implementation (`src/server/services/growth/service.rs`) correctly sync their message structures.

Bazel handles test caching and incremental builds, so it is necessary to run `bazelisk test //...` to ensure there are no breaking regressions across the mono repo. For specific component tests, target them precisely or just run the entire workspace.
A `lib.rs` file needs explicit `pub mod [name]` declarations when creating new backend components to expose them properly across the module system, especially under a `services` namespace.
